test_command: cd apps/web && npm exec -- playwright test --config tests/electron-e25a-playwright.config.ts && cd ../electron && node --experimental-vm-modules --test test/electron-shell.test.mjs test/security-smoke-receipt.test.mjs

criteria.text: A safe `https://` or `http://` markdown link in an agent transcript renders as a normal accessible link. Clicking or keyboard-activating it prevents renderer navigation and invokes a narrow `window.rhythmShell.openExternal(url)` capability. No `window.open`, popup, or renderer navigation.
criteria.reason: E25A Playwright proves one bridge call and unchanged page URL.

criteria.text: Preload exposes only `openExternal(url)` → IPC. Bump bridge version if repo conventions require it and update exact closed-surface receipt/tests.
criteria.reason: Preload test proves bridge version 7 and the single fixed IPC channel.

criteria.text: Main IPC requires the owned main document and exactly one string payload. Reject empty/oversized (>4096), malformed URLs, any username/password, non-http(s) schemes, extra args, foreign sender/frame/document. Only after validation call Electron `shell.openExternal(canonicalUrl)`.
criteria.reason: Electron tests cover canonical HTTP/HTTPS dispatch and the rejection matrix.

criteria.text: `javascript:`, `file:`, `data:`, custom schemes and whitespace/control-character tricks remain rendered as blocked non-links and never cross IPC. Preserve React-owned DOM/no HTML/image execution.
criteria.reason: E25A proves unsafe schemes and whitespace/control destinations are non-links with zero bridge calls.

criteria.text: In browser/dev without the Electron capability, safe links retain the current unavailable state (no navigation). If OS dispatch rejects, announce a concise `role=status`/alert failure without leaking internals.
criteria.reason: E25A covers disabled browser state and redacted local failure status.

criteria.text: Preserve link text and expose destination via title/accessible description. Add `rel="noopener noreferrer"` if an anchor is used, though navigation is prevented.
criteria.reason: E25A asserts exact text, title, href, and rel attributes.

criteria.text: Playwright proves a safe click calls the bridge exactly once and page URL stays put; keyboard activation works; unsafe links are not links; missing bridge remains disabled; screenshot shows safe clickable link and blocked unsafe copy.
criteria.reason: E25A covers click, keyboard, unsafe and missing states and writes the durable screenshot.

criteria.text: Electron tests prove allowlist/canonicalization and all rejection/ownership cases. Security receipt continues enforcing the exact frozen bridge surface. No generic shell or arbitrary IPC capability.
criteria.reason: Focused Electron tests pass 26/26 and enforce the exact frozen version-7 bridge surface.

criteria.text: Each enabled external link has a stable non-hover accessible description saying it opens `<hostname>` in the default browser, while preserving clean visible link text and title.
criteria.reason: E25A asserts each enabled link's aria-describedby target, sr-only text, and computed accessible description.

criteria.text: The link-local live region remains mounted and renders failure with visible separation as ` (External link could not be opened.)`.
criteria.reason: E25A asserts the mounted empty live region and exact separated failure text.
